description: Database, Redis, worker loops, and API cache performance. Covers all infrastructure-layer metrics.

panels.title: Active Connections
panels.description: Active TimescaleDB connections. Pool size is 10; overflow limit is 20.

panels.title: DB P99 Latency
panels.description: 99th percentile database query latency across all operations.

panels.title: Events Processed/s
panels.description: Total event processing throughput across all event types.

panels.title: Event Error Rate
panels.description: Percentage of events failing during processing.

panels.title: DB Query Latency — P50 / P95 / P99 by Operation
panels.description: Database query latency percentiles broken down by operation type.

panels.title: Events Processed by Type
panels.description: Event processing throughput by event_type and status.

panels.title: Redis Ops/s
panels.description: Total Redis operations per second across all operation types.

panels.title: Redis P99 Latency
panels.description: 99th percentile Redis operation latency.

panels.title: Redis Error Rate
panels.description: Rate of Redis operation errors per second.

panels.title: Redis Success Rate
panels.description: Percentage of Redis operations completing successfully.

panels.title: Redis Operation Rate by Type
panels.description: Redis operations per second broken down by operation type.

panels.title: Redis Latency — P95 by Operation
panels.description: 95th percentile Redis operation latency by operation type.

panels.title: Worker Heartbeat Age
panels.description: Age of the last worker heartbeat. Red > 60s — worker is likely stalled.

panels.title: Worker Loop Iteration Rate
panels.description: Worker loop iterations per second by loop name.

panels.title: Worker Loop Duration — P95
panels.description: 95th percentile execution duration for each worker loop.

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate
panels.description: Percentage of API requests served from cache across all endpoints.

panels.title: Cache Hit / Miss Rate by Endpoint
panels.description: API cache hit and miss rates per endpoint. High miss rate for a given endpoint = cache not warming.

panels.title: Cache Invalidations
panels.description: Cache invalidation events by pattern and trigger. Spikes indicate upstream data changes.

panels.title: Worker Task Status
panels.description: Per-task lifecycle status (0=starting 1=running 2=paused 3=crashed 4=stopped), consecutive crash count, and a per-task-scaled freshness ratio ((time since last cycle) / expected interval) for each of the worker sidecar's supervised background tasks. Ratio >=1 means the task is overdue for its next cycle relative to its own cadence; tasks with no fixed cadence show 'Event-driven' instead of a ratio.

panels.title: Broker Up
panels.description: Redpanda broker scrape health (job=redpanda, /public_metrics on :9644).

panels.title: Broker Disk Free
panels.description: Free bytes on the Redpanda data volume.

panels.title: Consumer Group Lag
panels.description: Max consumer-group lag per group (requires the enable_consumer_group_metrics cluster property). Retry republishes to a topic tail briefly inflate lag during retry storms — retried messages are genuinely pending.

panels.title: Topic Produce Rate
panels.description: Messages appended per second per topic (rate of the partition max offset).
